title: Natural Earth 1:50m Land
browserGeometry: Polygon triangulation with bounded Douglas-Peucker simplification (0.018 degrees desktop, 0.035 degrees mobile), spherical subdivision and extruded coastline walls.
limitations: Small-scale cartographic coastline, not surveyed site boundaries or a digital elevation model.
Procedural relief, colors and day/night lighting are art direction. They do not assert measured mountains, present snow cover, city lights or live time of day.
Natural Earth notes coastline accuracy concerns in northern Russia and southern Chile.
Simplification tolerances are angular rendering parameters, not statements of map positional accuracy.
